resolution: Re-audited against the newly fetched Engrossed in House (EH) text (passed the House 2026-04-27). The prior audit's suspected subsection (g) is confirmed present in the Engrossed text and is now COVERED in three fields (top_lines[2] 'Federal Guidance to States'; sections[1].items[1].detail appended guidance sentence; changes.added[2]) — all SUPPORTED, 0 new material. Subsections (a)-(f) are unchanged from the Introduced version (versionChanges records only (g) added) and were re-verified directly against the Engrossed text; all figures (5->10), directions (strike/redesignate, either/or pathway, weekly cert), and entities (Secretary of Labor, OMB) hold. 6 pre-existing minor style/framing opens carried forward.
notes: Amendatory bill (amends 26 U.S.C. 3306(t)); registered referencedSource usc-26-3306 (2024 edition) supplies pre-amendment base language (struck (t)(3)(B) 'likely to exhaust'; 5-percent cap base; allowance-in-lieu definition; (f)(6) fund-withdrawal). 0 material errors, 0 direction inversions. NEW vs prior (Introduced-based) audit: subsection (g) Secretary-of-Labor guidance directive is now in-source and covered. The Engrossed text OMITS the introducing-sponsor block, so the two likelihoodReason sponsor/cosponsor rows (Carey/Landsman, '6 cosponsors') are Zone-3 INPUT C structural metadata anchored to the AN ACT title line — permitted, not bill-text fidelity claims. 6 minor opens: (1) underreported + why_unreported recast the PERMISSIVE 2-year state-amendment clause (Section 2(e)) as a mandatory 'states must amend to be compliant' obligation [may->must, 3 rows]; (2) 'attract broad support' and 'Senate floor time limited' are unsourced likelihoodReason framing (class 8 style debt); (3) '[trust funds] vary significantly in reserves across states' is extrinsic context in gaps. sections[1].items[1].detail correctly uses the permissive 'states may amend' wording, so the may->must issue is isolated to the underreported field.
